moneyProfit.title: Profit & loss
moneyProfit.sub: What the shop earned in a period after its costs, from delivered orders. Only shows; nothing is paid or changed from here.
moneyProfit.period: {from} to {to} · by the day each order was delivered, in the shop's own time zone

kpi.orderedSub: Every order placed, shown beside Sales, never instead of it

lines.title: How the profit is made
lines.sub: From each delivered order's own profit; a part not known yet is left out and named below
lines.productCostHow: The ERP's cost on each line when it was ordered
lines.deliveryChargeHow: The charge on each delivered order
lines.courierHow: The charge on each real parcel
lines.paymentFeesHow: Online payments at your fee figures (Money → Costs & fees)
lines.packagingHow: Your packaging cost per order (Money → Costs & fees)
lines.adsNone: No ad spend imported for these days
lines.adsUnknown: not known: a day's spend has no taka amount yet
lines.otherHow: Daily cost lines, expenses, return losses and messages not about a delivered order (the Costs report)
lines.fixedHow: Salary, rent, utilities and other, spread over the days (Money → Costs)
lines.netUnknown: Not shown while the ad spend is not known

moneyProfit.uncosted: {n} delivered order(s) worth {amount} have no ERP cost on a line, so they are left out of every profit line (never cost 0): {skus}

missing.courier: {n} order(s) have a parcel without its charge yet
missing.paymentFees: {n} order(s) have an online payment without a fee figure
missing.packaging: {n} order(s) without a packaging cost: enter it on Money → Costs & fees

byDay.title: Day by day
byDay.sub: The newest first: delivered orders, gross profit and contribution
byDay.none: No delivered order in this period.
byDay.cut: Only the newest {n} days are listed here; the download has every day.
